about_the_game:
Rent a Girl is a visual novel featuring 8+ different endings based on your choices — a story about relationships, personal growth, and self-discovery.

You play as a shy university student in Tokyo who has always struggled to connect with others. After a humiliating experience exposes your social naivety, you find an unusual service: a girlfriend rental for social skills development.

What starts as a desperate attempt to overcome shyness turns into a journey of self-discovery, where "fake" relationships can reveal real truths about love, friendship, and personal growth.

✨ Key Features

  • 🌸 Engaging Story — A deep narrative about overcoming shyness and personal development

  • 👥 Multiple Heroines — Meet five unique girls with distinct routes, cultures, and personalities

  • 🎯 Relationship System — Your choices directly impact dialogues, events, and endings

  • 🏆 Achievement System — Unlock milestones as you explore different paths

  • 🌍 Multilingual Support — Available in 6 languages: English, Brazilian Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, and Russian

  • 🎵 Atmospheric Soundtrack — Music and sound effects crafted to enrich every scene

  • 🌙 High Replayability — 8+ different endings based on your decisions throughout the story

💖 Meet the Characters

  • Lin Mei — Energetic Chinese chef passionate about cooking and optimism

  • Seo-Yoon Kim — Serious and introspective Korean law student with a warm heart beneath her formal exterior

  • Ana — Vibrant and spontaneous Brazilian exchange student who celebrates life in every detail

  • Rin — Japanese manga artist, introspective and creative, with a unique worldview

  • Katya — Elegant Russian communication student, ambitious and passionate about fashion

  • Haruna — The classmate who started your journey — and perhaps your awakening

🎯 Who Is This Game For?

  • Character-driven narratives with complex, well-developed personalities

  • Romance with gradual and realistic emotional development

  • Stories about personal growth, overcoming shyness, and inner strength

  • Visual novels with multiple routes, endings, and high replayability

  • Mature themes handled with sensitivity and respect

  • Experiences exploring diverse cultures in a modern setting
